entities.name: Ivana Isailović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ivana Isailović is a professional volleyball player from Serbia, who was a member of the Serbia women's national volleyball team that won the silver medal at the 2007 European Championship in Belgium and Luxembourg. She currently plays for Schweriner SC.
